abstraction.hides: The narrow metadata role inventory and shared proof-section validation, separate from Git I/O and CI tool checks.
callersKnow: The manifest is parsed from the committed default path.
The fixed base equals the actual merge base.
File observations come from strict non-executable regular UTF-8 Git blobs.
Every other changed path and every tool comparison remains subject to the existing CI guard.
Classification grants no proof success, review result, or merge authority.
abstraction.deletionTest: Deleting ciProofRecords repeats metadata validation among the CLI effects and couples it to Git access.

alternatives.name: Reject every file outside CI
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Mandatory current proof records cannot accompany the CI adoption that needs them.

alternatives.name: Permit all declared proof inputs
alternatives.rejectedBecause: Models, controls, and implementation code can cause gate failures outside the CI change.

alternatives.name: Permit every formal Markdown file
alternatives.rejectedBecause: An unrelated document is not required proof metadata.

omitted: Arbitrary file contents and the separate parser internals collapse to seven truthful observations.
One record fault at a time is modeled. Combined faults remain implementation-control obligations.
The independent proof triple collapses to its successful admission result.
Semantic authority, host integrity, full review, exact-head CI, and merge conditions remain external obligations.

bounds: Four diff classes and eight record cases: valid or one of seven failed guards.
Tool equality, moved base, and independent proof validity are Boolean.
One classification followed by one independent proof decision.

negative.defect: Ignoring role separation admits a record that also supplies an implementation or authority input.

limits: Finite classification safety only. No liveness or eventual successful delivery claim.
The model assumes truthful schema, byte, role, tool, and base observations.
CLI controls establish selected implementation correspondence independently.
A CI mode result never supplies fresh TLC execution, a clean review stop, hosted success, or merge authority.
Existing proof admission and all exact-head review and CI requirements remain mandatory.
